notes: «وزاد ابن إسحاق حدثني ...» — Ibn Ishaq narrates the addition as the first link; «حدثني ابن أبي نجيح، وأبان بن صالح» are the two co-transmitters of the next level, and «عن عطاء، ومجاهد» the two of the level after.
No previous report is in the context, so the link to the earlier report of this book cannot be checked; the chain is read as written.
«قال تزوج النبي ...» — Ibn Abbas's words are the saying; the Prophet is the end of the chain.
